Strings.AdminLaunchError:

Please run this application as administrator and try again.

Strings.InstallFinished:
Installation finished. Right-click any executable to use Locale Emulator.
A reboot or Explorer restart may be required when upgrading from an older version.
Strings.UninstallFinished:
Uninstallation finished. Thank you for using Locale Emulator.
A reboot may be required to unlock some components.
Strings.GroupAllUsers: (1.2) Install for all users on this PC (requires administrator)
Strings.IntroText: Welcome to Locale Emulator! If you want to use LE without installation (as a portable application), you can close this window now. Otherwise, follow these steps: 1. Install Locale Emulator for yourself or for all users on this PC. 2. Run LEGUI.exe to customize the profile list. 3. Right-click an application and choose a Locale Emulator item.
